note: Old-town streets as paved rects [x0, z0, x1, z1] at street height: Bach Dang riverfront (brick promenade), Nguyen Thai Hoc and Tran Phu east-west (Tran Phu crosses the creek on the Japanese Covered Bridge and goes on west as Nguyen Thi Minh Khai), Le Loi and Nguyen Hue north-south beside the square. strings: silk-lantern strings across every street but the riverfront, every spacing metres, hung at height; the canopy streets (Nguyen Thai Hoc and Tran Phu, the lantern streets) also get criss-crossing diagonal strings, so their lanterns form a ceiling; arches: lantern arches over the street mouths (old_town_landmarks.mjs).

lantern_lights.note: The lantern light that lights Hoi An's night (unshadowed omni lights, built by HoiAnMap from these rules through HoiAnZones.lantern_lights(), hidden by day). The playfield is the brightest place on the map: the Mother Lantern and the square's poles light the lawn, the approach streets (approach.names: Le Loi, Nguyen Hue) and the riverfront in front of the square (riverfront.near_x) are brighter than the back streets (back.names), so the eye goes to the lawn. Each group: range metres, energy, colour (sRGB hex). streets: one pool every step metres along each street's centre line at height, approach / back overriding range and energy for the streets they name; riverfront: every `every`-th Bach Dang lantern post, every post within near_x of the square's centre line; stalls: every `every`-th An Hoi night-market stall; plaza: the square's four lantern poles; mother_lantern: the shrine's giant lantern over the lawn; extra: [x, y, z] for the temple gates, the bridges and the market.

arches.note: Lantern arches over street mouths: street = a streets[] name (the arch spans its rect across x), z = where it stands, height of the beam.

clutter.note: The pavement life at the street edges, batched by PropMultiMesh from HoiAnZones.lots(): food_stall (banh mi trolley, stools, diners, fruit seller), shop_spill (clothes rack, hats, jars, mannequin, bicycle, shopkeeper, browsers), crowd (people standing about). Along both edges of every street in `streets`, every step metres, inset metres in from the edge and facing the street's centre, the kinds taking turns; none within cross_margin of another street (junctions) or near the temple gates, the market and the Japanese Bridge. riverfront: food stalls in front of the Bach Dang houses (none in front of the square). plaza: crowds on the square's paving round the lawn [x, z, yaw].
